identity.name: Wegent
identity.one_liner: Open-source AI-native operating system for defining, organizing, and running intelligent agent teams.
identity.short_description: Wegent is an open-source AI-native operating system for defining, organizing, and running intelligent agent teams. It is relevant to bot and agent-team workflows where multiple assistants, roles, or chat-oriented agents need structure.

positioning.why_it_matters: Many bot workflows are becoming teams of agents rather than one chatbot. Wegent matters because it focuses on organizing and running agent teams as an operating system layer.
best_for: Users organizing AI teammates for chat and work coordination
not_for: Users who only need a single chat widget
Teams looking for a narrow Telegram or Discord bot

seo_article.intro: Wegent is an open-source AI-native operating system for agent teams.
seo_article.what_it_is: It helps define, organize, and run intelligent agents in a team structure.
seo_article.why_it_matters: The next wave of bots often looks like coordinated agent teams rather than one chatbot.
seo_article.how_it_works: Start with one small team of agents, define roles clearly, and test whether the system improves coordination over a single assistant.

faq.question: Is Wegent open source?
faq.answer: Yes. The GitHub repository is listed under the Apache-2.0 license.
